verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API (production server api.quo.com) with JSON responses, API-key authentication, published rate limits, and downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs. It also has a per-endpoint 'Try it' playground that runs against production and an explicit date-based versioning policy, so programmatic driving is clearly supported. The probe 404s are only at guessed OpenAPI paths on quo.com; the spec is hosted on S3, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
